meanAggregationBasis: Official key supplies + keys; original validation Table 1 explicitly describes theoretical midpoint 3.00 on 1-to-5 scale, supporting mean-scale presentation. The reviewed source does not state a special weighted or missing-data formula; do not claim a published missingness rule.
projectMissingRule: Project rule: require all 92 answers, each integer 1–5, before producing profile; do not impute or substitute neutral. Author missingness policy not located.
